en: And then we took only the encoder and unknown neural networks that we encoded into the latent space.

en: And these embeddings we put into a, you know, simple regression.

en: Obviously, this worked on this really small neural networks only and then homogeneous.

en: So they were all trained on the same data, same architecture.
